title: As Far from Land as Possible
summary: In an n x n grid with 0s for water and 1s for land, identify a water cell with the greatest distance to the nearest land cell, and report this distance.
statement: In an n x n grid with 0s for water and 1s for land, identify a water cell with the greatest distance to the nearest land cell, and report this distance. If no water or land is present, return -1. The distance is calculated as the Manhattan distance between cells.
constraints: Return -1 for all-land or all-water grids.
hints: Start a multi-source BFS from every land cell simultaneously.
Reject the two grids lacking either terrain type.
Expand layer by layer into unvisited water, marking it when queued.
The final BFS layer is the maximum of every water cell’s nearest-land distance.
editorial: The final BFS layer is the maximum of every water cell’s nearest-land distance.

tests.explanation: The center water cell is distance two from land.
The opposite corner is four steps from the sole land cell.
